author.title: AI-Powered Systems Engineer & Writer
author.bio: I build and operate distributed, low-latency financial trading platforms, architect enterprise automation engines, and research practical cybersecurity.

projects.name: Low-Latency Algorithmic Trading Platform
projects.description: Architected and built a distributed, event-driven algorithmic trading engine from scratch. Features microsecond-level tick data ingestion, real-time LTP streaming over WebSockets, automated multi-broker order execution, and continuous position risk monitoring.

projects.name: Enterprise MIS & Reporting Automation Engine
projects.description: Designed an automated financial data processing engine that eliminated manual spreadsheet reporting. Ingests raw multi-ledger data, reconciles complex stock and purchase schedules, and exports audit-ready financial registers in seconds.
